title: Mexican Sausage Grilled Meal
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Mexican dish featuring grilled sausage and a variety of spices. This recipe is perfect for a quick and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Mexican sausage
ingredients.notes: Choose a spicy or mild variety to suit your taste

ingredients.name: Dashin
ingredients.notes: Also known as dried oregano, this adds a smoky flavor to the dish

ingredients.name: Grilled meal
ingredients.notes: You can also use cooked rice or beans as a substitute

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: For brushing the sausage and meal

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher or sea salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.notes: Use black or white pepper, whichever suits your taste

instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat.
Slice the Mexican sausage into 1-inch pieces and brush with olive oil.
Grill the sausage for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, grill the meal (such as mixed greens or cooked rice) for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly charred.
Remove the sausage and meal from the grill and slice the sausage into smaller pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the grilled sausage, meal, and dashin.
Squeeze a tablespoon of lime juice over the top and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
